What the market accepts (bought not sold; damage BI; rising premiums anyway).
Commissions, book growth, broker–insurer alignment — structural not moral.

nfri_translations.insurance_bought_not_sold: London energy and property cover is renewed, not discovered — buyers accept rising damage premiums while availability sits outside the schedule.
nfri_translations.fortune_2000_parallel: Largest hyperscalers employ in-house risk managers and bespoke SLA structures; mid-market campuses and generators rely on traditional brokers and damage-first wordings.
nfri_translations.commission_incentive: Broker and MGA economics reward premium growth on familiar forms; availability products lack loss history to justify inventing.
nfri_translations.intelligence_work: Shopping carriers, filling ACORD schedules, reading connection registers, mapping constraint boundaries — complex rules, automatable.
nfri_translations.judgement_work: Deciding which curtailment channel dominates, whether basis risk is acceptable, how much correlated tail to keep net — taste built on years of placement.
nfri_translations.copilot: Cat modules, broker workbenches, parametric quote engines — sell productivity to the professional who remains accountable.
nfri_translations.autopilot: Register-native availability cover sold to the asset owner or CFO — outcome priced, not tool licensed.
nfri_translations.claims_surface: When curtailment becomes a contested BI claim, adjusting is intelligence-heavy (policy language vs damage schedule) and massively outsourced — yet still waits on physical cause.
nfri_translations.placement_surface: Commercial lines brokerage on standard energy schedules — fragmented, intelligence-heavy, ripe for register-native audit.
nfri_translations.work_vs_tool_budget: For every pound spent on underwriting software, multiples more go to broker fees, loss adjusting and outsourced processing — autopilots capture the work line.
nfri_translations.uk_register_parallel: Britain holds TEC, ECR and connections-gate registers in public form; pricing still runs on damage triangles — analogous to longitudinal data sitting unused in adjacent markets.
nfri_translations.platform_shift_insurance: Like cloud reshaped software delivery, register-native firmness and AI document agents reshape what gets underwritten blind vs measured before bind.

prose_rules: Open sections with scene or accepted wisdom before machinery.
Name incentive structure before calling the market wrong.
Use before/after contrast once per act maximum.
No Sequoia portfolio names on rendered site unless in existing cites.
Opportunity-map thinking: fragmented + intelligence-heavy + outsourced = wedge.
Platform shift language: business model transformation, not 'AI-powered' garnish.
